detail.title: AEKS300 Digital Kitchen Weighing Scale
detail.overview: TheANT AEKS300 Digital Kitchen Weighing Scaleis designed for accurate ingredient measurement with a maximum capacity of7kgand1g precision. Powered by advancedstrain gauge sensor technology, it provides reliable measurements for everyday cooking, baking, meal preparation, coffee brewing, nutrition tracking and portion control.
features: The scale supports multiple measurement units, allowing you to switch betweeng, ml, oz, lb and flusing the dedicated UNIT button. Its convenientTARE functionlets you subtract the weight of containers and measure ingredients accurately.

Featuring a durabletempered glass weighing platform, the AEKS300 has a slim, space-saving design that is easy to clean and maintain. The large52 × 18mm LCD display with backlightprovides clear visibility of measurements.

For convenient everyday operation, the scale includesAuto Power-Off, Low Battery Indicator and Overload Warningfunctions. It is powered by2 AAA batteries, included in the package, so it is ready to use straight out of the box.
The package includes theANT AEKS300 Digital Kitchen Scale, user manual and 2 AAA batteries. The product is backed by a30-month manufacturer warrantyfor added reliability and peace of mind.
